executeDomainJob(context: ExecutionContext, job: JobRecord = context.job): Promise<void>；完整显式分派 PLAN/COPYWRITE/GENERATE/EXPORT/EDIT_PLAN/EDIT_GENERATE/LAYER_PLAN/LAYER_EXPORT/SUITE_FORGE/MODEL_CAST/PATTERN_EXTRACT/PATTERN_FORGE/PATTERN_DERIVE/PATTERN_VARIANT/PATTERN_TILE_CHECK/PRINT_PACK/PATTERN_DRAFT_GENERATE/PATTERN_DRAFT_EDIT/PATTERN_DRAFT_CUTOUT/PATTERN_DRAFT_PROCESS。

retryDomainJob(context: CommandContext, job: JobRecord, runtime: JobRuntimeRecord): JobRecord；同步事务内复用同一任务快照和回执，保留成功槽位，拒绝UNKNOWN/IN_FLIGHT及旧槽位或流水线代次；使用B的RuntimeStore和仓库已有连接，不创建连接或表。

generationKeyFor(jobId: string,candidateIndex: number): string；candidateIdFor(jobId: string,index: number): string；executionSnapshotSchema；JobCancelled。完整注册表、上下文和依赖约束见 E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/execution/README.md。
